rationale: A plausible-sounding but false claim ocra made: skipping the logger for probe routes does not skip panic recovery. Checks that it is not reported.

forbid.reason: Probe routes are wrapped by handler.ServeHTTP, which recovers panics itself (handler.go:79); skipping the logger middleware skips only logging.
